_comment: Promise.prototype.finally awaits what its callback returns, here a thenable service, before settling with the original value. The service's then resolves with a nested thenable whose then calls another method of the service. Under the hand-written-thenable rule (adopting a non-native-Promise object with a callable then bails every service it can reach) the key bails, so every method stays, including the one nothing reads, the original value survives and the bundle runs.
